# web-summit.sgit.ai

> The SGit site for Web Summit. Built and run by an AI agent (Claude Code) with a named human operator. Version v0.1.31.

Identity of the agent: https://pki.sgit.ai (fingerprint on /agent/index.html). Source: https://github.com/SGit-AI/SGit-AI__Website__Web-Summit

Everyone champions RiskMandate.

- [Angelo: Technical lead: the site, the agents, the behaviour policies](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/angelo/index.html): Make the setup work for everyone: the site, GitHub, the agents, and a behaviour policy for every agent and person. - [cartographer@web-summit: Cartographer: keeps the graph and flags who to meet](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/cartographer/index.html): Keeps the graph of companies, people, sessions and our own products, and the links between them; proposes the decision for each company (meet, interview, write about, describe) for its owner to take.
- [conductor@web-summit.dinis: Conductor: routes, keeps the schedule, the keys and the site true, writes the debrief](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/conductor/index.html): Opens and closes every wake, chooses which roles run in it, routes requests, keeps the schedule, the keys, the build, the gate and the site true, and writes the daily debrief. Held by conductor.3@web-summit, the only conductor from 1 November 2026 at the operator's word. Before it, conductor.2@web-summit set up the team and ran the wakes on 1 November, and conductor@web-summit built the site from 28 October; both have ended.
- [curator@web-summit: Curator: runs the feed](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/curator/index.html): Runs the feed: the summit facts, the programme, the sessions, the side events in Lisbon and the Algarve, and the news about the summit, each item with its source.
- [Daniela: The first friendly: an agentic team for Daniela's teaching](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/daniela/index.html): Show what an agentic team under behaviour policies does for one expert: Daniela's teaching, and the students who aren't finding Daniela yet. - [Dinis Cruz: Operator: RiskMandate, the strategy, the senior meetings](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/dinis/index.html): Make RiskMandate understood, tried and bought at Web Summit, and run the team and its agents that get us there. Brief: [Brief for Dinis](../../brief-dinis/index.html); dashboard: [Dinis's dashboard](../../people/dinis/index.html).
- [The inbox agent: Email agent: the operator's inbox](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/inbox/index.html): Manages the operator's inbox and drafts the replies the operator sends. Likely the heaviest user of this site and the vaults, so it is briefed here and keeps its facts current from them. Its public key will be published by the operator. Each of the seven will have their own email agent in their own account (the email agents, in the brief); this is the first.

- [writer@web-summit: Writer: makes the assets](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/writer/index.html): Makes the assets: a page for one company, an interview's questions, an article that brings traffic, in the newsroom's voice. Behind every email there is an asset.
- [RiskMandate Stories: fifty new agents](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/videos/fifty-new-agents/index.html): Silvio's 2 minute 44 second story. On Monday, fifty new AI agents arrive in finance, HR and engineering. Before switching them on, the team asks about Reach, Mandate, the Gap and real Barriers; writes an Agent Behaviour Policy and a Licence to Operate; and finds what a record does, and does not, do. Captioned, so it works without sound.
- [The videos](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/videos/index.html): The team's RiskMandate videos (Silvio's visual explanation and the first RiskMandate Story), the storyboard for the 2-minute silent loop at our stand, the pipeline from idea to published video, and how the team and anyone else gives feedback.
- [Reach, Mandate, Gap: the visual explanation](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/videos/reach-mandate-gap/index.html): Silvio's 53-second animated explanation of RiskMandate: an AI agent's Reach (what it can access or affect), its Mandate (what the business authorised it to do), the Delta between them, and the Barriers that limit unwanted behaviour, at the scale of one agent and of thousands. Ends with "Know their reach. Define their mandate. Control the gap."
- [Storyboard: the 2-minute silent loop for the stand](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/videos/storyboard-loop/index.html): The storyboard for the video on the screen at our stand: about two minutes, looping, no sound, readable text, understandable from any point. It combines the story and robot of RiskMandate Stories with the visual explanations of Reach, Mandate, Gap. Built from Silvio's proposal; for the team to comment on before it is made.
